simple.meaning: נֵדֶה (nêdeh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a bounty (for prostitution).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H5078. nedeh נֶ֑דֶה (so Baer Ginsb; van d. H. נֵ֑דֶה ), noun masculine gift (on formation compare Ges § 84a c Ol § 144a Kö ii.1, 65 Ba NB § 12a ); — יִתְּנוּנֶֿ֑דֶה לְכָלזֹֿנוֺת Ezek 16:33 (|| נְדָבִים ).
